brief.text: Returns a zero value with the same issuer and currency.
Checks if this amount evaluates to zero when constrained to a specific accounting scale.

content.text: is a no-op, returns true only when the amount itself is zero. The
argument is ignored in that case. For IOU, the amount is rounded to the given scale using
mode and the result is checked for zero; if
short-circuits and returns the value unchanged, so this returns false for any non-zero amount.

returns.text: if this amount rounds to zero at the given scale,

description.text: The target accounting scale to evaluate against.
